population.span: we randomly assigned 14,264 patients with nonvalvular atrial fibrillation who were at increased risk for stroke

endpoint.span: the primary end point of stroke or systemic embolism

estimate.span: In the intention-to-treat analysis, the primary end point occurred in 269 patients in the rivaroxaban group (2.1% per year) and in 306 patients in the warfarin group (2.4% per year) (hazard ratio, 0.88; 95% CI, 0.74 to 1.03; P<0.001 for noninferiority; P=0.12 for superiority).

treatment_strategy.span: In a double-blind trial, we randomly assigned 14,264 patients with nonvalvular atrial fibrillation who were at increased risk for stroke to receive either rivaroxaban (at a daily dose of 20 mg) or dose-adjusted warfarin.

absent_reason.follow_up: The abstract does not state the duration or timepoint for the ITT estimate. Registry time frames of up to 4 years accompany on-treatment outcomes in per-protocol or safety populations and cannot be bound to this ITT estimate.

served_mismatch: The served HR and CI match the source's intention-to-treat result, but served_row.analysis_set incorrectly labels this estimate per-protocol. The per-protocol primary result is HR 0.79 with 95% CI 0.66 to 0.96.
